classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate one small soluble de novo protein candidate: RFdiffusion produces an unconditional 80–100 residue backbone, ESM3 evaluates joint sequence-structure consistency of the generated sequence, protein_qc computes scalar solubility and stability metrics, and rank_designs aggregates all evidence into a ranked candidate list.
assumptions: No target structure, hotspot residues, or binding partner are provided; unconditional backbone generation is used and scientific utility is limited to demonstrating workflow executability.
Backbone length 80–100 residues is a reasonable default for a small soluble globular protein; adjustable via params.length_min and params.length_max.

RFdiffusion unconditional mode outputs a backbone PDB and a backbone-derived placeholder sequence (poly-GLY or graph-extracted residues); ESM3 refines sequence-structure consistency from that starting point.
ESM3 is run with sequence and structure tracks to evaluate and refine the backbone-derived sequence jointly with structure.
Standard solubility proxies (GRAVY < 0, instability index < 40, pI 5–9, no polybasic patches) are treated as soft pass/fail criteria reflected in rank_designs scoring, not hard filters.
A single design is sufficient for a compact workflow; no sharding or foreach fan-out is required.
rank_designs top_k=1 is appropriate when only one candidate is produced.
ESM3 outputs a pdb_path from its structure track; this is passed to protein_qc to enable pLDDT computation from the predicted structure.

success_criteria.backbone_generated: rfdiffusion node completes and returns a PDB path and backbone sequence for a single 80–100 residue unconditional design
success_criteria.sequence_structure_evaluated: esm3 node returns a refined sequence and pdb_path from joint sequence-structure track generation
success_criteria.qc_computed: protein_qc node returns all five scalar metrics (pLDDT, polybasic, GRAVY, instability_index, pI) for the ESM3-refined candidate
success_criteria.ranked: rank_designs node returns a ranked list containing at least one candidate entry with a composite score derived from upstream predictions and QC
